subject: reasoning
question: Shivani starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east. She then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 7 km. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 10 km. She then takes a final right turn and drives 9 km and stops at point B. How far and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees unless specified)
solution:
• Shivani starts from point A and drives 11 km towards the east.
 
• She then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 5 km.
 
• She then takes a right turn and drives 7 km.
 
• She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km.
 
• She then takes a left turn and drives 10 km.
 
• She then takes a final right turn and drives 9 km and stops at point B
